title: Design System: Ittahad Uz Zaman Portfolio

marker-yellow.notes: Night theme highlight is the same yellow at 30% alpha; solid for selection and the now node.

margin-pink.notes: Night theme: #ff8fa8. Build value; the original brief named #e0476e.

field-blue.notes: Open Source section ground. Night theme: #1c35a8. Text #f4f7e8, hand and link accent #fff09a.

display.purpose: Hero headline in Bricolage Grotesque, 740, tight tracking, max 19ch.

hand.purpose: Shantell Sans marginalia: short tilted phrases, fact labels, tags.

label-mono.purpose: Geist Mono for dates, typed role line, email addresses only.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Paper-like objects: note card, build note, spreads, hovered primary button. Night uses black at 25/65/40%.

shadows.name: tape
shadows.purpose: Yellow tape strip on the note card.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing: hovers, tilts, highlight growth, reveals.

motion.name: highlight-draw
motion.value: background-size 0% to 100% over 1s (hero) or scroll view() entry 35% to 100%
motion.purpose: Marker highlight grows left to right.

motion.name: stroke-draw
motion.purpose: Pen circle, arrow, squiggle trace themselves.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0 and translateY(18px) to rest, view() entry 0% to 55%
motion.purpose: Section reveal; IntersectionObserver fallback; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy ink hand-cut button for the email action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: .85rem 1.4rem; font: 640 1rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.01em; background: #15203a; color: #e7edd8; border: 1.5px solid #15203a; border-radius: 255px 18px 225px 18px / 18px 225px 18px 255px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-1deg); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #15203a14, 0 18px 34px -16px #15203a59, 0 3px 8px -3px #15203a33; } .ds-btn:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px dashed #1f43d6; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action, e.g. copy email with mono address.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; padding: .85rem 1.4rem; font: 640 1rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; background: transparent; color: #15203a; border: 1.5px solid #15203a45; border-radius: 255px 18px 225px 18px / 18px 225px 18px 255px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f7f9ee; transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-1deg); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px dashed #1f43d6; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-addr { font: 500 .86rem 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Marker Highlight
components.description: Yellow band behind the lower half of key words.
components.css: .ds-title { margin: 0; font: 740 2.4rem/1.02 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.034em; color: #15203a; } .ds-hl { background: linear-gradient(#f7e35c, #f7e35c) 0 86% / 100% .56em no-repeat; padding-inline: .06em; margin-inline: -.06em; }

components.name: Taped Note Card
components.description: Tilted card stock with tape and hand-labelled facts.
components.css: .ds-note { position: relative; background: #f7f9ee; color: #15203a; padding: 2.2rem 1.6rem 1.4rem; transform: rotate(1.6deg); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #15203a14, 0 18px 34px -16px #15203a59, 0 3px 8px -3px #15203a33; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-note h3 { margin: 0 0 .9rem; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-note dl { margin: 0; } .ds-note dl > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6rem 1fr; gap: .8rem; padding: .62rem 0; border-top: 1.5px dashed #15203a45; } .ds-note dt { font: 500 .92rem 'Shantell Sans', 'Segoe Print', cursive; color: #1f43d6; } .ds-note dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tape { position: absolute; top: -14px; left: 50%; width: 112px; height: 30px; margin-left: -56px; background: #f7e35cd9; transform: rotate(-3.5deg); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px #15203a26; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; gap: .4rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-tags li { font: 500 .82rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: .2rem .65rem; border: 1.5px solid #15203a45; border-radius: 99px; color: #15203ad9; }

components.name: Now Sticker
components.description: Margin-pink blob marking the current role.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-block; font: 700 1rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e7edd8; background: #c42d55; padding: .05rem .75rem .15rem; border-radius: 40% 60% 55% 45% / 55% 45% 60% 40%; transform: rotate(-5deg); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Text link with marker band on hover and active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; } .ds-nav a { text-decoration: none; font: 520 .95rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #15203ad9; padding: .3rem .1rem; background: linear-gradient(#f7e35c, #f7e35c) 0 92% / 0% .5em no-repeat; transition: background-size .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .2s; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.is-active { color: #15203a; background-size: 100% .5em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px dashed #1f43d6; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Index Row
components.description: Ruled project index row that fills with marker yellow on hover.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.15rem .6rem; border-top: 1.5px dashed #15203a45; text-decoration: none; color: #15203a; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; background: linear-gradient(#f7e35c, #f7e35c) 0 100% / 100% 0% no-repeat; transition: background-size .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { background-size: 100% 100%; } .ds-row b { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-row span { color: #15203ad9; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a person's working notes, not an agency stage. Dot-grid notebook paper in pale pistachio carries blue-black ink; a ballpoint blue annotates and links; a yellow marker highlights; a margin pink ticks things off. Trust comes from first-person voice, handwriting, and marks that look made by a hand, then from dated entries, an index, clippings and repos.

Density is calm and editorial: large tight display type, generous section padding, small tilted paper objects that break the grid by a degree or two. The night theme is the same notebook after dark. The Open Source section is the one saturated moment, a full-bleed pen-blue field with its own lighter dot grid.
keyCharacteristics: Dot-grid paper ground on every light and night surface (26px pitch)
Four drawing tools only: ink, ballpoint, marker, margin pen
Handwritten marginalia as a distinct third voice, never body copy
Hand-wobbled shapes and 1 to 6 degree tilts on paper objects
Marks draw themselves on scroll (highlights grow, strokes trace)

rules.name: The Four Tools Rule
rules.body: Ink writes, ballpoint annotates, marker highlights, pink checks. A color used outside its tool's job is off-system.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Exactly one section is drenched in pen blue. Do not add a second.

rules.name: The Dates Only Rule
rules.body: Mono is for dates, the typed role line, and addresses. It never sets headings or body.

rules.name: The Margin Voice Rule
rules.body: Handwriting is short (a phrase), always tilted, always Ballpoint Blue (or Field Highlight on the field). Never a paragraph.

rules.name: The Real Paper Rule
rules.body: Only objects that could be a sheet of paper cast a shadow; text, rows, and chips never do.

dos: Do keep the dot grid under all paper surfaces and make the field section carry its own lighter grid.
Do use Ballpoint Blue for every link and annotation, with a 2px underline on text links.
Do tilt paper objects by 0.6 to 1.6 degrees and hand-script labels by 1.5 to 6 degrees; straighten on hover.
Do drive highlights and strokes with scroll (view timeline), fall back to IntersectionObserver, and render them fully drawn under reduced motion.
Do provide the night theme as a recolor of the same marks (chalk ink, lightened pen and pink, translucent marker).
donts: Don't return to dark monochrome with a single white accent, or to the hero plus card-grid agency template.
Don't add photos, stock imagery, or invented testimonials; proof is real roles, projects, writing, repos.
Don't use hard offset shadows, gradients as decoration, or glass; depth is paper-on-paper.
Don't set body, headings, or labels in the hand or mono faces outside their named jobs.
Don't use pink for anything but ticks and the "now" sticker, or add a second pen-blue field section.
